nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.card_says: The state corporation responsible for Kenya's urban roads.
nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.source_says: KURA's own page states it is mandated to "manage, develop, rehabilitate, and maintain national trunk roads within urban areas", a network it puts at about 4,625 km. Its remit on its own account is the national trunk roads inside urban areas, not urban roads generally.

source.title: Kenya Urban Roads Authority — Who we are

nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.card_says: The state corporation responsible for Kenya's national trunk roads.
nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.source_says: KeNHA's own page specifies the trunk network as "all National Trunk Roads comprising of Class S, A, and B roads", and says the authority was inaugurated and began operations in September 2008 under the Kenya Roads Act, 2007. The card is right but unspecific; the class list and the 2008 start are available if wanted.

nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.card_says: The Kenyan commission that values and pays for land taken by compulsory acquisition.
nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.source_says: The Commission's own history page lists its constitutional functions under Article 67(1) — managing public land for the national and county governments, land policy advice, title registration, research, investigating land injustices, assessing land taxes and premiums, overseeing land use planning — and does not mention compulsory acquisition or compensation among them. Not a contradiction: the acquisition and compensation role sits in the Land Act, 2012, which was not opened in this pass. The card's claim is unsupported by the body's own description and wants a Land Act citation.

santa-fe-road-19-expropriation.card_says: Argentina's national roads directorate, which funded the 6 km of Road 19 inside Cordoba province — stated in the present tense, as a body that exists.
santa-fe-road-19-expropriation.source_says: Decree 461/2025, signed 7 July 2025 and published 8 July 2025, dissolves the Dirección Nacional de Vialidad (Article 1) and gives the study, construction, conservation and improvement of the national trunk road network to the Ministry of Economy (Article 6), with references to the DNV in the governing decree-law redirected to that ministry. The DNV was in existence and acting at the time of the case; it was dissolved in July 2025.

source.title: Decreto 461/2025
source.publisher: Presidencia de la Nación Argentina (argentina.gob.ar, texto oficial)

santa-fe-road-19-expropriation.source_says: The 2025 decree recites Decreto-Ley N° 505/58 as the instrument that constituted the DNV as an autarchic body, and gives its latter-day jurisdiction as the Secretaría de Transporte of the Ministerio de Economía. It does not mention Ley 11.658 of 1932, the date commonly given for the DNV's creation. Flagged, not resolved: a 1958 decree-law reconstituting a body is not necessarily its creation.

kwabenya-landfill-expropriation.company: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development
kwabenya-landfill-expropriation.card_says: The ministry responsible for local government in Ghana — present tense.
kwabenya-landfill-expropriation.source_says: The ministry of that name no longer exists. In January 2025, under Executive Instrument 1, the Ministry of Local Government, Decentralisation and Rural Development was merged with the Ministry of Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs and the sanitation ministry to form the Ministry of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, which oversees 261 Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies. The card's name is the name the ministry carried at the time of the project.

source.title: Ministry of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, Medium Term Development Plan 2026-2029

rogun-stage1-resettlement.company: Open Shareholding Holding Company Barki Tojik
rogun-stage1-resettlement.card_says: Named on the card as "Open Shareholding Holding Company Barki Tojik", Tajikistan's state electricity company.
rogun-stage1-resettlement.source_says: The company's own audited consolidated financial statements give the legal name as Open Joint Stock Holding Company "Barqi Tojik" (OJSHC "Barqi Tojik"), registered with the Ministry of Justice on 3 June 1999, sole shareholder the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan, with the shareholder's support letter signed by the State Committee on Investment and Property Management. The map's spelling is the Bank document's rendering, not the company's own; not renamed here.

source.title: Barki Tajik entity audit report for the year ended December 31, 2018, Note 1
source.publisher: audited financial statements, hosted by the World Bank

rogun-stage1-resettlement.company: Open Shareholding Holding Company Barki Tojik
rogun-stage1-resettlement.card_says: Tajikistan's state electricity company — read as an undivided utility.
rogun-stage1-resettlement.source_says: A government decree of late April 2018 ordered the holding split into generation, transmission and distribution, and two new joint-stock companies, "Electricity Transmission Network" and "Electricity Distribution Network", were established on the basis of Barqi Tojik in 2018. The company's own 2018 accounts still state the principal activity as generation, transmission and distribution. The card holds for the case period; the structure changed from 2018 on.

source.title: Two new companies established on the basis of Tajik national power holding expected to start operations soon

rogun-stage1-resettlement.card_says: Named on the card as "Poyry Energy Ltd", the consultant that prepared the Rogun ESIA and the Stage 1 Resettlement Action Plan.
rogun-stage1-resettlement.source_says: No qualifying source naming this entity could be opened. The group it belonged to was Pöyry Plc, an international consulting and engineering company with net sales of EUR 580 million, about 5,500 employees and 120 offices in 40 countries in 2018; ÅF completed its acquisition of Pöyry on 21 February 2019 and the combined group now trades as AFRY. All of that is about the parent, not the named Ltd, and the Swiss and Austrian Pöyry energy entities (Pöyry Energy AG, Pöyry Energy GmbH, Pöyry Switzerland Ltd) appear under several names in non-qualifying directories, so which one the report meant is unsettled. Do not rename the card.

source.title: ÅF and Pöyry are now combined – new group structure and management team

nanchang-line-2-demolition.card_says: Named "Nanchang Urban Rail Group Co.", the implementing agency and "the URC" in the completion report.
nanchang-line-2-demolition.source_says: The registered name is 南昌轨道交通集团有限公司, rendered in the filing as Nanchang Rail Transit Group Co., Ltd.; the actual controller is the Nanchang municipal state-asset supervision commission, holding 100%. The map's key is the Bank report's rendering. Left as it stands.

source.title: Follow-up credit rating report on 南昌轨道交通集团有限公司, corporate bond disclosure
source.publisher: 联合资信 / Shanghai Stock Exchange disclosure platform

sutp-brts-corridor-displacement.company: Hubli-Dharwad Bus Rapid Transit System Company
sutp-brts-corridor-displacement.card_says: "The special purpose company set up for the Hubli-Dharwad bus rapid transit corridor in Karnataka."
sutp-brts-corridor-displacement.source_says: India's Comptroller and Auditor General lists it among Karnataka's working government companies in the infrastructure sector as "Hubli Dharwad BRTS Company Limited (HDBRTS)", with paid-up capital of ₹20 crore in its 2015-16 accounts, and defines a government company as one in which at least 51% of paid-up share capital is government-held. The report does not name the administrative department or the incorporation date. The corporate identity number quoted by company directories, U60200KA2012SGC063887, implies a 2012 state-government incorporation but no qualifying source for it was opened.

source.title: Report No. 3 of 2018, Public Sector Undertakings, Government of Karnataka — Chapter 1 and Appendices
source.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

sutp-brts-corridor-displacement.card_says: "The development authority for the new capital city of Naya Raipur in Chhattisgarh."
sutp-brts-corridor-displacement.source_says: Nothing was found that qualifies. Non-qualifying sources (encyclopedias, property portals, tender aggregators) give the body's current name as Nava Raipur Atal Nagar Vikas Pradhikaran, following the city's renaming to Atal Nagar; no government instrument or own-portal page confirming that rename could be opened. The enabling framework exists in Section 38(1) of the Chhattisgarh Nagar Tatha Gram Nivesh Adhiniyam, 1973, under which the state government may establish a town and country development authority by notification, but the notification naming this authority was not found. Flagged for a later pass; do not rename the card on the strength of an encyclopedia.

source.title: Chhattisgarh Nagar Tatha Gram Nivesh Adhiniyam, 1973 (Act 23 of 1973), ss. 2(v), 38(1), 40(c)(i)

bukoba-airport-resettlement-arrears.card_says: "The government authority that owns and runs Tanzania's airports."
bukoba-airport-resettlement-arrears.source_says: The establishment order makes it an executive agency in relation to the Department of Aerodromes, and its framework document gives its role as "to operate, manage, maintain and develop Government-owned airports" — the airports are government-owned, and the agency operates them. "Owns" overstates it.

source.title: Executive Agencies (Tanzania Airports Authority) (Establishment) Order, 1999, G.N. No. 404 of 1999
source.publisher: United Republic of Tanzania, via TanzLII

zhanghu-railway-resettlement.company: Huzhang Railway Passenger Dedicated Line Co., Ltd.
zhanghu-railway-resettlement.card_says: Case id "zhanghu-railway-resettlement" against a company named "Huzhang Railway Passenger Dedicated Line Co., Ltd." — the two orderings of the same line (Zhangjiakou–Hohhot / Hohhot–Zhangjiakou) sit on the same card.
zhanghu-railway-resettlement.source_says: Not resolved. The two National Development and Reform Commission project approvals opened in this pass cover different lines (Zhenglanqi–Zhangjiakou, where the project company is 河北集通正蓝张铁路有限责任公司 and Zhangjiakou Tongtai Holding Group is one of six investors, and Duolun–Fengning), not the 呼张 passenger line, so neither confirms the company's registered name or its shareholders. The investor names on the card are the completion report's; no state register entry for this company was opened.

source.title: NDRC approval, Zhenglanqi–Zhangjiakou railway, Heichengzi–Zhangjiakou section
